g.text: Development group n is one third of the development cohort (training tertiles). Validation outcomes use the fixed cut-points.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Model performance and survival findings (temporal validation unless stated)

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: • Group separation: log-rank p = 2.0 × 10⁻⁵² in validation; p = 1.4 × 10⁻⁷⁷ in development. Ordinal C-index 0.603.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: • Discrimination: C-index 0.622 (95% CI 0.608–0.636) in validation vs 0.595 in development (apparent).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: • Calibration: predicted 5-y survival 40.8% vs observed 46.6% (O/E 1.14); the model under-predicts survival.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: • Evaluable at 5 years: 26% of validation patients (median follow-up: development 5.89 y, validation 1.47 y).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: • Secondary outcome: median recurrence-free survival 2.03 years (95% CI 1.98–2.09).

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3d4b5a

g.text: Excluded counts are differences between consecutive steps.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3d4b5a

g.text: Events = deaths within the 15-year analysis window. Development recorded deaths: 4,685; 10 of these fall beyond 15 years and are censored in the models.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3d4b5a

g.text: TNM = tumour-node-metastasis; M2a = stratified Cox model; KM = Kaplan–Meier; O/E = observed/expected;

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3d4b5a

g.text: IBS = integrated Brier score; RFS = recurrence-free survival.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3d4b5a

g.text: Every number is read from the locked v8 outputs by make_paper1_figures.py; see verification_report.md.
